title: Connect a Telegram Business bot
goal: Grant a specific bot access to selected chats in a Telegram account with explicitly chosen permissions, then verify the active Business connection.

evidence.scope: Telegram documents connected Business bots. A general AgentOS connection adapter has not been implemented or verified.

prerequisites: The bot belongs to the user or an authorized operator and supports Telegram Business connections.
The user can review the selected chats and permitted actions before connecting.
A user MTProto session is not required for manual Business bot connection.

flows.when: The Business bot is ready and the user has chosen chats and permissions.

steps.action: Enable the bot capability needed for Telegram Business connection if it is not already enabled.
steps.proof: Telegram shows that the bot can be connected to a Business account.

steps.action: Show the exact chat scope and permitted actions before connection.
steps.proof: The user confirms the displayed access scope.

steps.action: Connect the bot in Telegram with the selected chat scope and permissions.
Read the current Business connection, its permissions and state; perform an authorized safe test.
steps.proof: Current connection and rights match the confirmed choice, and the test result is recorded.

recovery: Do not report a successful connection without current Telegram confirmation.
Explain how the owner can change rights, pause the bot, or disconnect it.
